# Codereadr

CodeREADr is a mobile data collection and barcode scanning platform that enables businesses to create and manage services for data capture, validation, and reporting.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/codereadr/.

## Actions

- **Collect Data With Questions**: Configure data collection forms by adding custom questions.
- **Configure CodeREADr Kiosk Mode**: Enable and configure Kiosk Mode for unattended scanning.
- **Configure CodeREADr Postback URL**: Configure a real-time postback URL for a CodeREADr service.
- **Configure Direct Scan URL (DSU)**: Configure a Direct Scan URL (DSU).
- **Configure Picking, Delivery & Receiving App**: Configure the complete picking, delivery, and receiving workflow.
- **Create CodeREADr Service**: Create a new workflow configuration (service) for scanning tasks.
- **Delete CodeREADr Database**: Delete an existing CodeREADr database.
- **Delete CodeREADr Service**: Delete an existing CodeREADr service.
- **Delete CodeREADr User**: Delete an existing user account.
- **Delete Custom Question**: Delete an existing custom question.
- **Delete Device**: Delete a device.
- **Generate Scan Link** (read-only): Generate a CodeREADr scan link URI.
- **List Supported Barcode Types** (read-only): List supported barcode types.
- **Manage CodeREADr Response Fields**: Create or update response fields returned with scan data.
- **Retrieve bulk scan records** (read-only): Retrieve bulk scan records.
- **Retrieve CodeREADr Databases** (read-only): List all validation databases.
- **Retrieve CodeREADr Services** (read-only): List all services.
- **Retrieve Devices** (read-only): Fetch registered devices.
- **Set Admin PIN**: Set or update the administrator PIN for Kiosk Mode.
- **Update CodeREADr Question**: Update an existing custom question.
- **Update CodeREADr Service**: Update an existing service configuration.
- **Configure CodeREADr Connector** (read-only): Helper to guide configuring the CodeREADr Connector for Google Sheets.
